title: CoBit: Language Modeling with Bitstream Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2605.07013v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce CoBit, a continuous diffusion language model that generates text by jointly denoising fixed-width binary token codes. Grouping each code's bits into a single Transformer patch preserves sequence length while replacing vocabulary-wide predictions with $\lceil\log_2 V\rceil$ bit logits. A matched-filter residual parameterization supplies the analytic isolated-bit posterior, leaving the network to learn contextual corrections. Stochastic sampling on an entropy-rate grid provides the largest empirical gain; the grid allocates both solver resolution and effective Langevin correction to noise levels where information is resolved. At 256 denoiser evaluations, CoBit-S (130M parameters) achieves generative perplexity 59.76 on LM1B and 27.06 on OpenWebText, at unigram entropies 4.31 and 5.26, respectively. translated_title: CoBit：基于比特流扩散的语言建模
translated_abstract: 我们提出了CoBit，一种连续扩散语言模型，它通过联合去噪固定宽度的二进制词元编码来生成文本。将每个编码的比特分组为单个Transformer补丁，在保持序列长度的同时，用⌈log₂ V⌉个比特logit取代了覆盖整个词表的预测。匹配滤波残差参数化提供了孤立比特的解析后验，使网络只需学习上下文修正。在熵率网格上进行随机采样带来了最大的实证增益；该网格将求解器分辨率和有效的朗之万修正分配到信息被解析的噪声水平上。在256次去噪评估下，CoBit-S（1.3亿参数）在LM1B上实现了59.76的生成困惑度，在OpenWebText上实现了27.06，对应的单字熵分别为4.31和5.26。扩展到4.62亿参数后，在熵为5.40时，OpenWebText的生成困惑度提升至19.48。除开放式文本生成之外……（摘要截断）
tldr: CoBit是一种连续扩散语言模型，通过联合去噪固定宽度的二进制词元编码生成文本，用比特级logit替代词表级预测，并借助熵率网格上的随机采样在生成困惑度上取得显著提升。
en_tdlr: CoBit is a continuous diffusion language model that generates text by jointly denoising fixed-width binary token codes, replacing vocabulary-wide predictions with bit-level logits and achieving significant generative perplexity improvements through stochastic sampling on an entropy-rate grid.
